_comment: Hand-maintained overrides for scripts/generate-node.js. Existing operations carry their current display name/value/action and per-field UI metadata verbatim (FIELDS is not auto-rewritten — see the Lunch Money n8n Custom Node vault doc, 2026-08-01, for why). New spec operations without an entry here fall back to mechanical derivation and are flagged in the sync PR for review. knownPathDerivedFields are field names driven by generateOperationHandler special-case routing code (not general spec params/bodyProps) and are excluded from the spec-divergence check to avoid false positives.

getMe.desc: Get details about the current user

getBudgetSummary.name: Get Summary
getBudgetSummary.desc: Get a summary of the user account

required.name: start_date
required.desc: Start of date range in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD)

required.name: end_date
required.desc: End of date range in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD)

optional.name: include_exclude_from_budgets
optional.desc: Include categories that have the "Exclude from Budgets" flag set

optional.name: include_occurrences
optional.desc: Include an occurrences array for each category showing activity per budget period

optional.name: include_past_budget_dates
optional.desc: Include three budget occurrences prior to the start date (requires Include Occurrences)

optional.name: include_totals
optional.desc: Include a top-level totals section summarising inflow and outflow

optional.name: include_rollover_pool
optional.desc: Include a rollover_pool section summarising the current rollover pool balance and previous adjustments

required.name: name
required.desc: Name of the category. Must be between 1 and 100 characters and unique.

optional.name: description
optional.desc: Description of the category. Must not exceed 200 characters.

optional.name: is_income
optional.desc: If true, transactions in this category are treated as income.

optional.name: exclude_from_budget
optional.desc: If true, transactions in this category are excluded from the budget.

optional.name: exclude_from_totals
optional.desc: If true, transactions in this category are excluded from totals.

optional.name: is_group
optional.desc: If true, the category is created as a category group.

optional.name: group_id
optional.desc: If set to the ID of an existing category group, this new category will be assigned to that group. Cannot be set if is_group is true.

optional.name: archived
optional.desc: If true, the category is archived and not displayed in the Lunch Money app.

optional.name: order
optional.desc: Index specifying the display position on the categories page.

optional.name: collapsed
optional.desc: If true, the category group appears collapsed in the Lunch Money app. Only applicable to category groups.

optional.name: children
optional.desc: JSON array of existing category IDs or names of new categories to add to this category group. Only applicable when is_group is true.

optional.name: force
optional.desc: Set to true to force deletion even if there are dependencies.

getAllTransactions.name: Get Many
getAllTransactions.desc: Get all transactions with optional filters

optional.name: start_date
optional.desc: Beginning of the time period to fetch transactions for (YYYY-MM-DD).

optional.name: end_date
optional.desc: End of the time period to fetch transactions for (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if start_date is set.

optional.name: created_since
optional.desc: Filter to transactions created after this timestamp. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 datetime.

optional.name: updated_since
optional.desc: Filter to transactions updated after this timestamp. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 datetime.

optional.name: category_id
optional.desc: Filter to transactions associated with the specified category ID. Also matches category groups. Set to 0 to filter for uncategorized.

optional.name: tag_id
optional.desc: Filter to transactions that have a tag with the specified Tag ID.

optional.name: recurring_id
optional.desc: Filter to transactions associated with the specified Recurring Item ID.

optional.name: plaid_account_id
optional.desc: Filter to transactions associated with the specified Plaid account ID. Set to 0 to omit Plaid transactions.

optional.name: manual_account_id
optional.desc: Filter to transactions associated with the specified manual account ID. Set to 0 to omit manual account transactions.

optional.name: status
optional.desc: Filter to transactions with the specified status.

optional.name: is_group_parent
optional.desc: If true, return only transaction groups (parent transactions).

optional.name: is_pending
optional.desc: If true, return only pending transactions. If false, return only non-pending transactions.

optional.name: include_pending
optional.desc: By default, pending transactions are excluded. Set to true to include imported transactions with a pending status.

optional.name: include_metadata
optional.desc: If true, include custom and Plaid metadata in the response.

optional.name: include_split_parents
optional.desc: By default, transactions that were split are not included. Set to true to include them.

optional.name: include_group_children
optional.desc: By default, individual transactions that joined a transaction group are not included. Set to true to include them.

optional.name: include_children
optional.desc: If true, include the children property containing split or grouped child transactions.

optional.name: include_files
optional.desc: If true, include the files property containing a list of attached files for each transaction.

optional.name: limit
optional.desc: Maximum number of transactions to return.

optional.name: offset
optional.desc: Number of records to skip for pagination.

required.name: child_transactions
required.desc: JSON array of child transactions. The sum of amounts must match the parent transaction amount. Each item needs at minimum an "amount" field.

optional.name: date
optional.desc: Date of the transaction in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

optional.name: amount
optional.desc: Numeric amount without currency symbol.

optional.name: payee
optional.desc: New payee for the transaction.

optional.name: currency
optional.desc: Three-letter lowercase ISO 4217 currency code.

optional.name: category_id
optional.desc: Category to assign. Set to null to clear.

optional.name: notes
optional.desc: New notes. Set to empty string to clear.

optional.name: status
optional.desc: Transaction status.

optional.name: recurring_id
optional.desc: ID of a recurring item to associate. Set to null to clear.

optional.name: tag_ids
optional.desc: Comma-separated tag IDs. Overwrites any existing tags on the transaction.

optional.name: additional_tag_ids
optional.desc: Comma-separated tag IDs to add without replacing existing tags.

optional.name: external_id
optional.desc: User-defined external ID (requires manual_account_id).

optional.name: manual_account_id
optional.desc: ID of the manual account. Set to null to disassociate.

optional.name: plaid_account_id
optional.desc: ID of the Plaid account to associate. If set, manual_account_id may not also be set.

optional.name: custom_metadata
optional.desc: User-defined JSON data that can be set or cleared via the API.

optional.name: update_balance
optional.desc: Set to false to skip updating the account's balance when changing the transaction.
